## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For UI changes, include a screenshot using disposable data. For migrations or deployment changes, describe the upgrade and rollback validation.

## Review

- [ ] Changes stay within the agreed scope and preserve the SDK package boundary.
- [ ] Credentials, private data, and generated test artifacts are excluded.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and behavior tests are updated.
